items.guidance: The file name container/builder.dockerfile suggests a builder stage, so check whether a separate runtime Dockerfile or final stage in the container directory already defines the production entrypoint, and mirror that command. Although the runtime is detected as go, confirm what the image actually runs (for example a Python WSGI server) from repository scripts or documentation before writing the CMD.

Application port 5000 was detected, so verify that the production server binds to 5000 on 0.0.0.0 in its settings or start command before declaring EXPOSE 5000. Only add ENV PORT if the source actually reads a PORT variable; otherwise the bind address is likely set in the app's own settings file.
